Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 13. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses *1. Country of Origin & Chinese Components - Strictly Prohibited:* The offered product and all its components, parts, sub-assemblies, firmware, software, sensors, lens, chips et, PCB, etc. should not be manufactured in China, nor should any Chinese brand / Chinese OEM part be us ed in it. The product should be of Indian origin or from a friendly country, in compliance with DPIIT Make in India Order and Govt. of India instructions on security. *2. Undertaking to be Submitted:* The bidder must submit a self-declaration / undertaking on company letterhead stating: > "We hereby certify that the offered Long Range Camera and all its components, hardware, firmware and software are free from any Chinese parts / components / technology, and no data is transmitted to any ser ver located in China.

*3. Data Security & No Backdoor:* Camera me koi bhi hidden backdoor, remote access, unauthorized data transmission facility nahi honi cha hiye. Camera ka data sirf authorized Indian server / NVR / Command Centre par hi store hoga. Camera kisi bhi foreign cloud server se connect nahi hoga. *4. Server / Cloud Location:* Agar camera me cloud / remote viewing facility hai, to uska server / data centre 100% India me hi located hona chahiye. Foreign server par data store karna strictly prohibited hai. *5. Certification Required:* Bidder ko ye documents dena hoga: *a.* Country of Origin Certificate *b.* OEM Authorization Certificate *c.* No Chinese Component Certificate *d.* BIS / CE / FCC Certification, jaisa lagu ho *6. Inspection / Verification:* Supply ke baad, buyer dwara kisi bhi samay product ki checking karwai ja sakti hai. Agar checking me koi bhi Chinese part / component paya gaya, to supply reject kar di jayegi aur firm ko blacklist karne ki karya wahi ki jayegi. Uska poora kharcha seller ko uthana hoga. *7. Compliance with Govt. Security Guidelines:* Product ko Ministry of Home Affairs / MeitY / Govt. of India ke dwara jaari security guidelines ka poora pala n karna hoga. .
